$comment: Curated seed list. Every entry is verified by scripts/enrich.mjs against GitHub/npm/pub.dev; entries that fail verification are reported, never silently kept. kind: library | platform | css-framework | reference (closed source, docs only). styling: tailwind | css-in-js | css | css-modules | web-components | native | utility-props. orgBacked: maintained by a known company, government or institution (traction override).

systems.name: shadcn/ui
systems.bestFor: Modern SaaS and AI apps on React/Next.js + Tailwind where you want to own and restyle component source.

aiOverrides.tokens: Theme is CSS variables (globals.css) generated per registry theme; see ui.shadcn.com/docs/theming

systems.name: Ant Design

systems.name: Chakra UI

systems.name: Mantine
